name: Get STRONG for Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Get STRONG for Brainrots! 💪

🏋️ Upgrade your STRENGTH!

👍 Like the game and join the group for MORE UPDATES!

🖥️ Experience it on PC, mobile, tablet, or console, with full controller compatibility.
